name: rendobar
description: Serverless media processing for AI agents. Run FFmpeg jobs on files from your disk.
long_description:
Rendobar runs media jobs in the cloud and hands back a hosted URL. This bundle is the local server, so an agent can take a video off your machine, run an FFmpeg command against it on Rendobar's infrastructure, and return the result without you touching a browser.

Beyond raw FFmpeg there are purpose-built job types for timeline composition, compression to a size budget, subtitle burn-in, animated captions, and media inspection. Call `list_job_types` to read the current set live.

The server starts without an API key so its tools can be listed. Tool calls need a key, which you can set below or write once with `rb login` from the Rendobar CLI.

api_key.title: Rendobar API key
api_key.description: Starts with rb_. Get one at https://app.rendobar.com under Settings, API Keys. Optional here: the server also reads RENDOBAR_API_KEY or the credentials file written by `rb login`.
